title: PLAYER 2'S CROWBAR AND BLASTS ACT LIKE THE HOST'S
why: When player 2 hit a pillager with the crowbar, a frag charge or an air strike, the host treated it like a gun shot: the pillager could dodge roll out of the way, it counted toward pinning him down, and a big hit froze him for a beat. None of that happens when the host does the same thing; it is meant for gun shots only. Proven in the cloud: the host's crowbar on a pillager gave no roll and no pin count, player 2's crowbar on the same pillager rolled him away and counted toward the pin. Now player 2's crowbar, frag charges, finishers and air strikes tell the host they are not gun shots, and the host treats them exactly as its own. Damage and who gets the kill are unchanged; player 2's gun shots are unchanged.
now: Player 2's crowbar, frag charges and air strikes hit a pillager the same way the host's do.
